places.name: Mount Vesuvius
places.ai_summary: An iconic volcano known for its eruption in 79 AD that buried Pompeii and Herculaneum, offering hiking trails and panoramic views.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the hike.
places.address: Mount Vesuvius, Naples, Italy

places.name: Pompeii Archaeological Site
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site showcasing the preserved ruins of the ancient Roman city buried by Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD.
places.place_tip: Hire a guide to fully appreciate the history.
places.address: Pompeii, Naples, Italy

attribution.title: Theathres of Pompeii
attribution.author: ElfQrin
attribution.description: Theaters of Pompeii seen from above with a drone, with Mt. Vesuvius in the background

places.name: Naples National Archaeological Museum
places.ai_summary: One of the most important archaeological museums in the world, housing artifacts from Pompeii and Herculaneum.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Secret Cabinet collection.
places.address: Piazza Museo, Naples, Italy

attribution.title: Natmuseumnaples
attribution.author: Jeffmatt at English Wikipedia
attribution.description: Private photo taken and uploaded by user Jeffmatt 08:21, 25 September 2006 (UTC). No rights claimed.

places.name: Castel dell’Ovo
places.ai_summary: A seaside castle with a rich history, offering stunning views of the Bay of Naples and the city.

opening_hours.notes: Access may be restricted during events.

places.place_tip: Explore the marina area nearby.
places.address: Via Eldorado, 3, 80132 Napoli NA, Italy

places.name: Castel Nuovo (Maschio Angioino)
places.ai_summary: A medieval castle and symbol of Naples, featuring a museum and offering panoramic views from its towers.
places.place_tip: Visit the museum inside for historical artifacts.
places.address: Via Vittorio Emanuele III, 80133 Napoli NA, Italy

attribution.title: Municip
attribution.author: Little john at Italian Wikipedia

places.name: Piazza del Plebiscito
places.ai_summary: The main public square in Naples, known for its impressive architecture and as a venue for events and concerts.
places.place_tip: Check the schedule for events and concerts.
places.address: Piazza del Plebiscito, 80132 Napoli NA, Italy

places.name: Royal Palace of Naples
places.ai_summary: A historic palace with opulent rooms and a rich collection of art and artifacts, reflecting the history of Naples.
places.place_tip: Visit the Palatine Library inside.
places.address: Piazza del Plebiscito, 1, 80132 Napoli NA, Italy

attribution.title: Napoli 2019 -Royal Palace - San Francesco di Paola- by-RaBoe 074
attribution.author: © Ra Boe / Wikipedia

places.name: Naples Underground (Napoli Sotterranea)
places.ai_summary: A fascinating tour through the underground tunnels and chambers of Naples, revealing the city's ancient Greek and Roman roots.
places.place_tip: Bring a light jacket, it can be cool underground.
places.address: Piazza San Gaetano, 68, 80138 Napoli NA, Italy

places.name: Catacombs of San Gennaro
places.ai_summary: Ancient Christian burial sites with fascinating frescoes and architecture, offering a glimpse into early Christian history in Naples.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and bring water.
places.address: Via Capodimonte, 13, 80136 Napoli NA, Italy

places.name: Spaccanapoli Street
places.ai_summary: A famous street in the historic center of Naples, known for its vibrant atmosphere, shops, and restaurants.
places.place_tip: Try the local street food.
places.address: Spaccanapoli, 80134 Napoli NA, Italy

places.name: San Carlo Theatre
places.ai_summary: The oldest continuously active opera house in the world, renowned for its opera performances and stunning architecture.
places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for performances.
places.address: Via San Carlo, 98, 80132 Napoli NA, Italy

attribution.title: Teatro de San Carlos, Nápoles, Italia, 2023-03-25, DD 184-186 HDR
attribution.author: Diego Delso

places.name: Galleria Umberto I
places.ai_summary: A public shopping gallery with an impressive glass dome, featuring shops, restaurants, and a beautiful interior.
places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at one of the historic cafes.
places.address: Via Giuseppe Verdi, 80132 Napoli NA, Italy

attribution.title: Inside of Galleria Umberto I - Naples 2013-05-16 14-11-46 1 DxO
attribution.author: Berthold Werner

places.name: Via Toledo
places.ai_summary: A major street in Naples known for its shopping, dining, and vibrant street life.
places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for hidden gems.
places.address: Via Toledo, 80132 Napoli NA, Italy

places.name: Santa Chiara Monastery
places.ai_summary: A beautiful medieval monastery with a stunning cloister and a rich history, located in the heart of Naples.
places.place_tip: Visit the museum and the archaeological area.
places.address: Via Santa Chiara, 49, 80134 Napoli NA, Italy

places.name: Certosa di San Martino
places.ai_summary: A former monastery turned museum, offering stunning views of Naples and a rich collection of art and artifacts.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Carthusian Monastery complex.
places.address: Salita San Martino, 5, 80129 Napoli NA, Italy

places.name: Museo di Capodimonte
places.ai_summary: An art museum located in a grand palace, featuring works by Caravaggio, Titian, and other masters.
places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding park area.
places.address: Via Miano, 2, 80131 Napoli NA, Italy

places.name: Lungomare Caracciolo
places.ai_summary: A scenic waterfront promenade in Naples, perfect for a leisurely stroll, with views of the Bay of Naples and Mount Vesuvius.

opening_hours.notes: Very popular, especially in the evenings.

places.place_tip: Enjoy gelato from a nearby vendor.
places.address: Lungomare Caracciolo, 80122 Napoli NA, Italy

places.name: Quartieri Spagnoli
places.ai_summary: A vibrant neighborhood in Naples known for its narrow streets, historic buildings, and lively atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Very lively, especially in the evenings.

places.place_tip: Try the local tapas bars.
places.address: Quartieri Spagnoli, 80134 Napoli NA, Italy

places.name: Piazza del Gesù Nuovo
places.ai_summary: A beautiful square in Naples, known for its stunning church and as a lively meeting place.
places.place_tip: Visit the church of Gesù Nuovo.
places.address: Piazza del Gesù Nuovo, 80134 Napoli NA, Italy

attribution.title: Facciata della chiesa del Gesù Nuovo (Napoli) - BW 2013-05-16
attribution.author: Berthold Werner

places.name: Castel Sant’Elmo
places.ai_summary: A medieval fortress with a star-shaped design, offering panoramic views of Naples and the bay.
places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding area for great views.
places.address: Via Tito Angelini, 22, 80129 Napoli NA, Italy
